rule:
Cumulative reliability table of OUR MODEL's own probabilities (not the market's).

Sources (pregame only, one grade per unique leg, pushes/voids excluded):
  lists     official frozen v1 lists (Props 50 / All 100 / Alt 50) rows with prob_source='model'.
            calibration='market_blend' rows are excluded (their hit_prob mixes in the market).
  forecasts locked model forecasts (forecasts table, y graded); side = the side the model favours,
            break-even from that side's best captured price.
  pick_log  app-surfaced picks with a model_prob, shown before start; prob = model_prob of the
            selected side; break-even = venue_implied (Dabble per-leg / Kalshi ask).
Market-implied / market-derived rows are excluded everywhere.
Buckets: 50-60, 60-70, 70-80, 80-90, 90-95, 95+ (rows <50% reported as '<50').
Run: python3 scripts/model_reliability.py  -> data/iteration/model_calibration.{md,json}
